messages:
Anjali (SRE): Quick follow-up from the postmortem for the Mar 23 cache-thundering incident — we need to lock down customer-facing comms and owners. TL;DR: status copy draft, 72h summary, decide detailed-RCA sharing level, and identify recurring-pattern owners.

Sara (Ops): I can take the status copy draft. ETA EOD Thu.

Mike (Product): I’ll review. Can we aim for short FAQ-style language instead of a long page? Keep it non-technical.

Tom (Support): I’ll prepare the customer-facing summary for affected accounts (account list + mitigation steps). Need final wording by Fri morning to send queued outbound messages.

Anjali (SRE): For RCA sharing — proposal: publish a concise public incident summary on the status page + put the detailed RCA in a gated doc for customers who request it (via support request). Rationale: transparency + avoids exposing internal config diffs. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Mike (Product): +1. Gated detailed RCA sounds right for enterprise customers. For the public summary, use headings: what happened / impact / what we did / next steps.

Sara (Ops): Draft status copy (v1) below — will iterate inline. Plan to post after approvals.

Sara (Ops) (status copy v1):
```
What happened
On Mar 23, a cache eviction bug caused intermittent increased latency for a subset of generation requests in our hosted inference service.

Impact
We observed a spike in 95th/99th percentile latency for text-generation endpoints affecting approximately 4% of requests between 02:14–02:43 UTC. No data exposure.

What we did
We reverted the recent cache configuration change, deployed a hotfix to the eviction heuristic, and enabled additional KV-layer logging to monitor stability.

Next steps
We are completing a full RCA and will share a summarized timeline publicly. A detailed RCA is available on request for affected enterprise customers. Action items and mitigations are tracked internally.
```

Anjali (SRE): Owners & deadlines (proposed) — please confirm or reassign: 
- Fix eviction heuristic + add unit/integration tests — owner: Anjali (SRE) — due: 2 weeks
- Add synthetic load tests for cache churn and CI jobs — owner: Mike (Product) + Eng-ML lead — due: 4 weeks
- Customer communication package + FAQ + exec summary — owner: Sara (Ops) — due: 3 business days
- Proactive outreach to dedicated-instance customers — owner: Tom (Support) — due: tomorrow COB

Tom (Support): I’ll compile affected customer list and draft messages. Who handles gated-RCA requests? Ops/support or sales?

Sara (Ops): Ops will gate requests. Use support@redwood.com and our request form; escalate enterprise requests to sales/solutions as needed. Ops will share the request process in the reply template.

Mike (Product): Recurring-pattern check — is this the 3rd cache-related incident in the last 6 months? If yes, Eng-ML should own a quarterly systemic review.

Anjali (SRE): Confirmed: similar burst/cache churn issues in Oct and Jan. I’ll set up a recurring "incident pattern review" with Eng-ML + SRE. First session: next Tue.

postmortem-bot: Reminder: Action items were added to the postmortem tracker. Tracker link: https://internal.redwood/pms/PM-1234

Sara (Ops): Small wording note — in customer-facing copy, prefer "reverted a configuration change" over "rolled back". Also removing internal tool names. Updating the draft accordingly.

Mike (Product): LGTM on the approach. :thumbsup:

Tom (Support): On it — will share affected-account list by EOD and post the customer draft to the thread for quick sign-off.

Anjali (SRE): I’ll update the postmortem tracker with PR refs and expected PR dates once the fix branch is open. Will ping when the RCA draft is ready for review (expected ~1 week). Thanks all.
